summary: The Backrooms is a multiplayer survival RPG spanning Level 0, the mall, The Hub and authored destinations; player.state holds the character while solo and multiplayer runs retain separate story, quest and resume state. Global scripts and shared registries coordinate play, while place scenes and simulations compose local spaces and stories. Multiplayer mode starts without story in the Bonus Rooms and uses party-shared rooms beyond the mall.
places: places/main (3D) - Level 0 yellow maze, routes and anomalies; momentsV gates wall moments/room-prop regeneration; objects.scene hosts shared controllers.
places/bonus + places/testlab (3D) - vaporwave mall with shops, staff, arcade, homes and salon; Test Range has loot/enemy bays and HIT SQUAD pad.
places/thehub (3D) - tunnel crossroads, keyed destinations and Camp Amber crews; sim builds tunnels/doors and staffs camps; t5-a2 leads to Level 178.
places/intake + places/tutorial0 (3D; tutorial0 solo/ephemeral) - character creation/waking and staged tutorial office route; scenes own geometry, sims/cutscenes local beats.

places/level1 + places/level1c + places/level2 + places/level4 + places/level26 (3D) - Level 1 M.E.G. camp and signed entry to the 620 m Corrupted Corridor; Level 1.1 sim lays cast, caches and supplies.
places/level9 + places/level10 + places/level11 + places/level61 + places/level70 (3D) - Suburbs, farm, city/Base Beta/strip mall/clinic, Snackrooms checkpoint and Froidetown.
places/level169 + places/level132 (3D) - Level 169 desert, Ferry's house/trail/basement and Field Office 7; Level 132 Duchy of Morigont, Lumiria town, collection barter and generated countryside.
places/level178 + remaining authored levels (3D) - Kyoto Dreams residents/house quests/searchable containers; Level ! Chapter 2 chase finale and other authored destinations.
roots: world.config.yaml + templates/player.js - multiplayer/player entry, camera and ordered behaviors/actions; fall-guard precedes movement; radio, barter and phone are player behaviors.
places/<place>/config.yaml + cells/*.scene + sim.js - local configuration, authored placements and generation/tick behavior; Level 1.1 and Level ! sims coordinate local stories.
places/level169/config.yaml + scripts/terrain169.js; places/level132/config.yaml + scripts/terrain132.js - seeded height/material generators and place terrain marks.
places/level169/sim.js + scripts/lib/data/level169.yml + house/Ferry/Friends/road/Robotics helpers - desert setpieces, schedules, routes, quests and units.
places/level132/sim.js + scripts/lib/data/level132.yml + scripts/lib/l132-*.js - town/countryside lay and tick orchestration for stalls, shops, land, people, Duke, quests and barter.
places/level178/config.yaml + scripts/terrain178.js + x0z0.scene + sim.js - Kyoto terrain, house, residents, arrival quest, finds, containers and breakable sweep.

scripts/main-menu.js + scripts/main-menu-ui.js + scripts/lib/run-opts.js + scripts/ui.js - title/save lifecycle, Solo/Multiplayer switch, expedition choices and HUD; the Game Rules button is outside the HUD (retained in god-mode tabs).
mods/director-savi/commands/director-savi.md → skills/director-savi.md - separate trailer planning, filming and delivery workflow.
shared: scripts/lib/places.js - canonical place names/labels/HUD titles; consumed by feed, quest names and scripts/ui.js.
scripts/lib/grid-path.js - configurable 4-neighbor grid BFS/cache/cell selection shared by Level 0, 1, 2, 2.1, 3, Boiler and 6 adapters.
scripts/lib/ambush-smiler.js - common pursuit/lurk/wake/retreat/bite behavior configured by l34-smiler.js and l9-smiler.js; companion.js/carry.js handle followers and held-prop transfers.

scripts/lib/hub.js + scripts/lib/thehub.js + scripts/lib/hubkeys.js - Bonus room routing, Hub tunnel/door/key registry; hub-thing picks up loose keys and hub-route guides the Tenth Tunnel; multiplayer leaves Bonus into mpRoom().
scripts/lib/mp-guard.js - multiplayer-room detection and nonlethal NPC-down rule; scripts/player.js and scripts/meg-agent.js invoke spared().
scripts/lib/containment.js - Level 109 persistent pen/loose-foe and door books; sim supplies room IDs/boxes and spawnFoe adapter.
scripts/lib/prop-interactions.js + interactive-props data - shared usable-prop/container migration and geometry specs; scripts/interact.js dispatches.
scripts/lib/barter-deal.js + scripts/lib/screen.js + scripts/phone.js + phone-ui.js - shared barter valuation, wrist-panel exclusivity and phone apps.
notableExports: scripts/lib/grid-path.js - DIRS, createGridPather; places/level10/sim.js - cadence, tick.
scripts/lib/ambush-smiler.js - stepAmbushSmiler; l34-smiler.js and l9-smiler.js - configured update handlers.
scripts/lib/companion.js - PERKS, perkOf, isMine, followersOf, loyaltyScale, whyNot, recruit/adopt/dismiss/order, weapon handoff, tick, bring; carry.js - carryAcross.
scripts/lib/ui-kit.js - esc, uiPrefsOf/Attrs, escKeyHandler, emptyState, classifyNotice/noticeToast; scripts/lib/save.js - SAVE_V, canSaveHere, wakePlace, migrate.

scripts/lib/quests.js - journal/advancement/reward helpers; scripts/lib/containment.js - pen/door operations; scripts/lib/run-opts.js - OPTS, DEFAULTS, RATE, PRESETS, runOf, noStory, noNpcs, isMulti, mpRoom, MODE_SLOT, isStoryKey.

scripts/lib/mp-guard.js - shootable, multiRoom, spared; scripts/lib/dialogue.js - DLG, dlgReady, warmDialogue, archOf, entryOf, BYE_CHOICE, rootChoices, childChoices, nodeOf, greetingOf, lineOf, barkOf.
scripts/lib/l132-shops.js - RANGE, ears, lay, tick; scripts/lib/level169-quest.js - questTick, useThing; scripts/lib/voices.js - warmVoices, hasVoice, voiceKey; places/thehub/sim.js - cadence, tick.
ownership: scripts/player.js + scripts/lib/save.js - durable character player.state: progression/XP, health/sanity, inventory/equipment/ammo, needs, combat, access, appearance/look, currency and gear shared across Solo/Multiplayer.
scripts/lib/stats.js - derived attributes, skills and combat/carry stats; scripts/stats-ui.js formats; scripts/lib/progression.js migrates xpCurve progression.
scripts/lib/modifiers.js - bookBonuses/readBooks/genericBooksRead/effects and modifier derivation; scripts/lib/clothes.js owns worn gear records/passives.
scripts/lib/manuals.js + scripts/player.js - player.state.recipes learned IDs; legacy manuals grants recipe kinds; reading a manual learns one recipe.

scripts/lib/run-opts.js + scripts/main-menu.js - mode and run picks; run/quest/story/resume keys are swapped per mode through SQL save slots 91/92, while character, level, gear, cash and look remain on player.state.
scripts/db.js + scripts/main-menu.js - SQL saves table owns named save-slot snapshots and hidden Solo/Multiplayer mode snapshots; live character state remains player.state.
scripts/main-menu.js + tut0-cut.js + tutorial.js - player tutorial beat and Field Guide state/preferences, including seen prompt IDs; barter.js and phone.js own their player-state panels/apps.
places/level1c/sim.js + scripts/lib/level1c-quest.js - place state builtV/l1cPh/xV/l1cDead; player state holds per-walker sector/quest/passage/fall progress.
flows: world.config.yaml actions → templates/player.js ordered locomotion, player/foe, swim/climb/crawl, interaction, combat, inventory, social, hub, camera, quest, CCTV, radio, barter and phone behaviors; scripts/interact.js dispatches focused interactions.

templates/player.js runs scripts/fall-guard.js before movement; place changes hold velocity for ground streaming, grounded positions refresh session fgSafe, and out-of-bounds restores it or leaves for spawn.

world.config.yaml camera → scripts/camera.js; view3 writes player.state.tp/orbit → camera and aimPt/aimPitch → ballistics/weaponAim; camera derives eye height from worn body/model and critter-head; scripts/player.js builds the local first-person arm rig; body3 uses camera aim + combat-anims.yml for third-person pose.
scripts/player.js wake → scripts/lib/save.js migration/log/wakePlace; valid savePlace crosses to saved place and savePos restores coordinates; player update calls clockHeal on arrival.

scripts/main-menu-ui.js mode action → scripts/main-menu.js switchMode → SQL MODE_SLOT snapshots; isStoryKey fields swap while character/gear/look persist, then Multiplayer routes to Bonus and Solo to its saved place.
scripts/main-menu.js Multiplayer start → skips tutorial/story and goes to The Bonus Rooms; scripts/lib/run-opts.js noStory treats multiplayer as story-off and isMulti identifies its run.
scripts/lib/run-opts.js mpRoom(party/user) → scripts/lib/hub.js toSolo → party room mp-<party> (or user room); player wake avoids resuming a Multiplayer save in a solo room.

scripts/lib/mp-guard.js multiRoom → scripts/player.js damage and scripts/meg-agent.js death handling → ordinary NPCs are restored at 30% HP, stunned and shown DOWN; shootable/born-hostile/killable NPCs still die.

scripts/main-menu.js requests furry bodyStyle; scripts/lib/critter-model.js setStyle clears HUMAN for the critter body, while scripts/critter.js can instead render the avatar selected by player.state.look.spawnAv.
scripts/routing.js requested room → scripts/lib/hub.js Bonus solo-room selection; threshold handlers call carryAcross for held props/followers; Bonus/world/room links are excluded.
scripts/player.js zone resolver → player.state.zone (Level 1.1 sectors, Level 178 house, Level 132 Lumiria); scripts/lib/places.js → feed, quest labels and scripts/ui.js HUD titles/markers/compass.

places/level1c/sim.js tick lays versioned geometry/cast, then xV lays supplies, payphone note/audio and seams; xV is separate from builtV. Salon/creator model tab → scripts/ui.js plyUpload → scripts/lib/plyimport.js converts and uploads GLB.
behaviorFamilies: scripts/lib/data/furniture.yml + build-piece.js + build.js + home reconstruction - furniture-specific models/dimensions through common placement, persistence and rebuild; dining_set composes table and fitted chairs.
scripts/lib/data/weapons.yml + scripts/player.js + ballistics.js + knock.js + loot.js - weapon variants share combat and rarity/level gates; weights and upgrade rolls vary by level.

scripts/door-geo.js + door-swing.js + prop-interactions.js + interactive-props data + prop-part.js - parametric doors/storage, legacy migration and paired leaves; thresholds/sign boards share geometry.
scripts/crawl.js + scripts/player.js + humanoid-locomotion.js + scripts/lib/data/player.yml - global crawl/crouch and gait; held crouch initiates crawl and tight spaces trigger automatic crawl.
scripts/lib/l169-road.js + l169-road-geo.js + l169-travel.js + l169-door.js - checkpoint structures vary by site and geometry kind; streamed props include route boards and animated doors.

places/level132/sim.js + l132-{stalls,shops,land,people,duke,quests,barter}.js + barter-deal.js - staged town and keeper trades use eight goods categories; first gift then balanced currency-free barter.
scripts/phone.js + phone-ui.js + screen.js - one shared wrist phone; apps include keeper contacts/restock texts, camera/photos/notes, flashlight and radio.

scripts/lib/dialogue.js loads authored YAML lazily into shared DLG; scripts/talk.js consumes choice/line/bark helpers and warms recorded voice takes on first standing tick; scripts/lib/tutorial.js selects contextual Field Guide prompts.
probableOrphans: scripts/balloon26-geo.js - procedural balloon geometry exists; Level 26 placements/barrage use uploaded models.
scripts/hairtest-rig.js - marked temporary hair lane rig; no current references found.
art/critter-hair-tripo/fit.py.held - saved fitter copy; active fit.py is documented build fitter.
scripts/dbg-pose.js - debug-room mannequin gallery after places/debug removal; no current placement found.
scripts/dbg-bodypad.js + scripts/debug-pad.js - debug-room pads after places/debug removal; no current references found.
scripts/lib/data/l178-skins.json - slot-to-texture skin table has no current consumer; x0z0.scene carries material overrides inline.
migrationNotes: Solo and Multiplayer share one character but not run/story state: scripts/lib/run-opts.js isStoryKey defines the swapped key family; MODE_SLOT 91/92 are separate SQL snapshots and hidden from ordinary Save Manager slots.
Multiplayer's room ID is mp- plus sanitized party ID (or user ID); hub.js selects it only when leaving Bonus in multiplayer. Continue must not wake a multiplayer save into a solo room.

scripts/lib/mp-guard.js only spares NPC-tagged, non-overboard targets in rooms with a multiplayer player; shootable includes attackOnSight, killable, l8-hostile, born-hostile Ezra/Tobit and Lightless faction.

The Hub run frame/coordinates and OPEN/KEYED/SEALED door mapping are centralized in scripts/lib/thehub.js; preserve IDs and destinations together. t5-a2 is OPEN to Level 178; l178-to-hub pairs with sim-created hub-from-l178.
Level 169 uses x/z, north = -z and 1:10 map scale; terrain marks, track, house, road sites, Field Office 7 and ship berth align with level169.yml. Sim layout and well versions are separate.

Level 1.1 geometry uses hall distance along +X (0–620 m), north at -Z, with sector boundaries in level1c.js; xV gates extra props independently of builtV, and the doorway/seam-return markers stay paired. Third-person animation channels can outlive session state on reload: body3 seeds its channel sentinels before replacing/clearing aim and ready; arcade-play likewise checks its anim channel, not only session.arcOn. First-person plyarm is a local camera-attached model; its rotation/offset and model-keyed rig rebuild are deliberate view alignment.
